name: tmux-agentic-plugin
description: tmux status strip, picker and notifications for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode agent sessions.

interface.shortDescription: See what every coding agent in tmux is doing.
interface.longDescription: A tmux plugin that shows which Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode agents are working, ready, blocked or idle in a status-bar strip, jumps to them from a picker and sends local desktop notifications when one needs input.
